title: Ruby
label: Ruby
desc: Dynamic, object-oriented language built around blocks, mixins, and convention over configuration.

sections.title: Setup
sections.description: Check the interpreter, start a bundle, and run a script

snippets.code:
# Check the interpreter on the PATH
ruby -v

# Open the interactive shell
irb

# Evaluate a one-line script
ruby -e 'puts "hello from Ruby"'

# Run a file
ruby greet.rb

# frozen_string_literal: true

# greet.rb
# Usage: ruby greet.rb Grace
name = ARGV.first || "world"
puts "hello, #{name}"

# Start a Gemfile in the current directory
bundle init

# Add gems and record them in the Gemfile
bundle add rack
bundle add minitest --group test

# Install exactly what the lockfile records
bundle install

# Run a script with the bundle's versions
bundle exec ruby greet.rb

sections.title: Syntax
sections.description: Comments, variables, expression values, and naming conventions

snippets.code:
# frozen_string_literal: true

# A comment runs to the end of the line.
name = "Grace"        # local variables are snake_case
age = 36
MAX_TRIES = 3         # constants start with an uppercase letter

# Interpolation only happens inside double quotes.
puts "hello, #{name}"
puts 'hello, #{name}'

# Parentheses are optional around arguments.
puts age + 1

# Every expression returns a value.
status = age >= 18 ? "adult" : "minor"
puts "#{name} is #{status}"

# Semicolons are optional; two spaces per indent level.

first, second = 10, 20
first, second = second, first
puts first   # 20
puts second  # 10

head, *tail = [1, 2, 3, 4]
puts head           # 1
puts tail.inspect   # [2, 3, 4]

# Underscore-prefixed names signal unused values.
_, kept = ["drop", "keep"]
puts kept           # keep

def valid?(value)      # ? marks a predicate
  !value.nil?
end

def normalize!(text)   # ! warns of mutation or surprise
  text.strip!
  text
end

title = "  ruby  "
normalize!(title)
puts title          # ruby
puts valid?(title)  # true

sections.title: Types
sections.description: Numbers, symbols, nil, ranges, and explicit conversions

snippets.code:
count = 42
ratio = 0.75
label = :ruby         # Symbol: immutable, interned name
active = true
missing = nil

puts count.class      # Integer
puts ratio.class      # Float
puts label.class      # Symbol
puts missing.nil?     # true

puts 7 / 2                 # 2, integer division
puts 7.0 / 2               # 3.5
puts 2**10                 # 1024
puts 10.divmod(3).inspect  # [3, 1]
puts 0.1 + 0.2             # 0.30000000000000004

puts "42".to_i          # 42
puts "3.5".to_f         # 3.5
puts Integer("42")      # 42
puts Float("3.5")       # 3.5
puts 42.to_s            # 42
puts :ruby.to_s         # ruby
puts "ruby".to_sym      # ruby

# Strict conversions raise instead of returning zero.
begin
  Integer("forty-two")
rescue ArgumentError
  puts "not a number"
end

puts nil.to_a.inspect   # []
puts nil.to_s.inspect   # ""

puts (1..5).to_a.inspect      # [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
puts (1...5).to_a.inspect     # [1, 2, 3, 4]
puts ("a".."c").to_a.inspect  # ["a", "b", "c"]

# Only false and nil are falsy.
[0, "", [], false, nil].each do |value|
  puts "#{value.inspect} => #{value ? 'truthy' : 'falsy'}"
end

name = "  Grace Hopper  "
puts name.strip                  # Grace Hopper
puts name.strip.upcase           # GRACE HOPPER
puts name.include?("Hopper")     # true
puts name.start_with?("  G")     # true
puts name.length                 # 16
puts name[2, 5]                  # Grace
puts name.split.inspect          # ["Grace", "Hopper"]
puts "a,b,c".split(",").inspect  # ["a", "b", "c"]
puts "banana".sub("a", "o")      # bonana
puts "banana".gsub("a", "o")     # bonono
puts "ruby".center(8, "-")       # --ruby--
puts "7".rjust(3, "0")           # 007

printf("%s scored %d points\n", "Ada", 98)
puts format("%.2f", 3.14159)      # 3.14
puts "id-%03d" % 7                # id-007
puts "%s/%s" % ["2024", "11"]     # 2024/11

price = 19.5
puts "total: $#{price * 2}"       # total: $39.0
puts "total: $%.2f" % (price * 2) # total: $39.00

text = <<~TEXT
  Dear Grace,
  Your balance is #{40 + 2}.
TEXT
puts text

# Double-quoted strings are mutable unless frozen.
greeting = +"hello"   # unary + gives an unfrozen copy
greeting << "!"
puts greeting         # hello!
puts greeting.frozen? # false

sections.title: Arrays and Hashes
sections.description: Arrays, hashes, and the methods that replace manual loops

snippets.code:
fruits = %w[apple banana cherry]
fruits << "date"               # shovel appends
fruits.push("elderberry")
puts fruits.inspect            # ["apple", "banana", "cherry", "date", "elderberry"]
puts fruits[0]                 # apple
puts fruits[-1]                # elderberry
puts fruits.first(2).inspect   # ["apple", "banana"]
puts fruits.length             # 5
puts fruits.include?("banana") # true
puts fruits.join(", ")

puts [3, 1, 3, 2].uniq.sort.inspect     # [1, 2, 3]
puts [1, [2, [3, 4]]].flatten.inspect   # [1, 2, 3, 4]
puts [nil, 1, nil, 2].compact.inspect   # [1, 2]
puts [4, 8, 15].sum                     # 27

inventory = { apples: 12, pears: 4, plums: 0 }
puts inventory[:apples]          # 12
inventory[:pears] += 1
inventory[:kiwis] = 9
puts inventory.fetch(:apples)    # 12
puts inventory.fetch(:mango, 0)  # 0, default when missing
puts inventory.key?(:plums)      # true

inventory.each { |item, qty| puts "#{item}: #{qty}" }
puts inventory.keys.inspect
puts inventory.transform_values { |qty| qty * 2 }.inspect
puts inventory.select { |_, qty| qty.zero? }.keys.inspect  # [:plums]

votes = Hash.new(0)              # missing keys read as 0
%w[red blue red green red].each { |color| votes[color] += 1 }
puts votes.inspect               # counts per color

config = { db: { host: "localhost", port: 5432 } }
puts config.dig(:db, :port)      # 5432
p config.dig(:db, :user)        # nil

queue = [1, 2, 3]
puts queue.shift                 # 1, removes from the front
queue.unshift(0)
puts queue.inspect               # [0, 2, 3]
puts queue.pop                   # 3

sections.title: Control Flow
sections.description: Conditionals, case matching, and the loop forms worth using

snippets.code:
score = 82

if score >= 90
  grade = "A"
elsif score >= 80
  grade = "B"
else
  grade = "C"
end
puts grade                       # B

puts "pass" if score >= 60       # modifier form
puts "not zero" unless score.zero?

def classify(value)
  case value
  when 1..5 then "low"
  when 6..10 then "high"
  when String then "text"
  else "unknown"
  end
end

puts classify(3)      # low
puts classify("x")    # text
puts classify(99)     # unknown

hour = 14
case
when hour < 6 then puts "night"
when hour < 12 then puts "morning"
when hour < 18 then puts "afternoon"
else puts "evening"
end

sections.title: Blocks and Iterators
sections.description: Closures passed to methods, with yield and Enumerable

snippets.code:
numbers = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
puts numbers.map { |n| n * 2 }.inspect                  # [2, 4, 6, 8, 10]
puts numbers.select(&:even?).inspect                    # [2, 4]
puts numbers.reject(&:odd?).inspect                     # [2, 4]
puts numbers.reduce(0) { |sum, n| sum + n }             # 15
puts numbers.sum                                        # 15
%w[ant bee cat].each_with_index { |name, i| puts "#{i}: #{name}" }
puts numbers.each_with_object([]) { |n, acc| acc << n * n }.inspect

words = %w[apple pie cherry]

# Braces bind tightly; do...end binds to the outer call.
puts words.map { |w| w.upcase }.join(" ")   # APPLE PIE CHERRY

words.each do |word|
  puts word.length
end

total = words.map do |word|
  word.length
end.sum
puts total   # 14

def wrap
  puts "[start]"
  yield "payload" if block_given?
  puts "[end]"
end

wrap { |body| puts body.upcase }
wrap

def apply_twice(value)
  yield(yield(value))
end
puts apply_twice(3) { |n| n + 1 }   # 5

sections.title: Methods
sections.description: Positional, keyword, and splat arguments with implicit returns

snippets.code:
def greet(name, greeting = "hello")
  "#{greeting}, #{name}"
end

puts greet("Grace")        # hello, Grace
puts greet("Ada", "hi")    # hi, Ada

def connect(host:, port: 5432, timeout: 5)
  "host=#{host} port=#{port} timeout=#{timeout}"
end

puts connect(host: "localhost")
puts connect(host: "db.internal", port: 6432)

def stats(*numbers, scale: 1)
  return 0, 0.0 if numbers.empty?
  total = numbers.sum * scale
  [total, total.to_f / numbers.size]
end

total, average = stats(4, 8, 12, scale: 2)
puts total     # 48
puts average   # 16.0

def options(**flags)
  flags
end
puts options(color: "red", size: 3).inspect  # collected as a hash

def even?(n)
  n % 2 == 0
end

def shout(text) = text.upcase + "!"

puts even?(10)       # true
puts shout("ruby")   # RUBY!

sections.title: Classes
sections.description: State, inheritance, and immutable value objects

snippets.code:
class Account
  attr_reader :owner, :balance

  def initialize(owner, balance = 0)
    @owner = owner
    @balance = balance
  end

  def deposit(amount)
    raise ArgumentError, "amount must be positive" unless amount.positive?
    @balance += amount
    self
  end

  def to_s
    "#{@owner}: #{format('%.2f', @balance)}"
  end
end

acct = Account.new("Grace")
acct.deposit(50).deposit(25)
puts acct.balance   # 75
puts acct           # calls to_s

class Vehicle
  attr_reader :wheels

  def initialize(wheels)
    @wheels = wheels
  end

  def describe
    "a vehicle with #{wheels} wheels"
  end
end

class Bike < Vehicle
  def initialize
    super(2)
  end

  def describe
    "a bike: #{super}"
  end
end

puts Bike.new.describe   # a bike: a vehicle with 2 wheels

Point = Data.define(:x, :y) do
  def distance_to_origin
    Math.sqrt(x**2 + y**2)
  end
end

p1 = Point.new(x: 3, y: 4)
p2 = Point.new(x: 3, y: 4)
puts p1.distance_to_origin  # 5.0
puts p1 == p2               # true, value equality

sections.title: Modules and Mixins
sections.description: Namespaces, shared behavior, and method lookup order

snippets.code:
module Greeting
  def greet
    "hello from #{self.class}"
  end
end

class Person
  include Greeting
end

puts Person.new.greet   # hello from Person

module MathUtil
  module_function

  def double(n)
    n * 2
  end
end

puts MathUtil.double(21)   # 42

module Version
  VERSION = "2.1.0"
end
puts Version::VERSION

module Loud
  def speak
    super.upcase
  end
end

class Dog
  prepend Loud

  def speak
    "woof"
  end
end

puts Dog.new.speak                  # WOOF
puts Dog.ancestors.first(3).inspect # [Loud, Dog, Object]

sections.title: Exceptions
sections.description: Rescue, ensure, custom errors, and retry

snippets.code:
def read_age(text)
  Integer(text)
rescue ArgumentError
  warn "not a number: #{text.inspect}"
  0
ensure
  puts "checked #{text.inspect}"
end

puts read_age("36")
puts read_age("thirty")

class InsufficientFunds < StandardError
  def initialize(needed)
    super("short by #{needed}")
  end
end

def withdraw(balance, amount)
  raise InsufficientFunds, amount - balance if amount > balance
  balance - amount
end

begin
  withdraw(50, 80)
rescue InsufficientFunds => e
  puts e.message   # short by 30
end

puts withdraw(50, 20)   # 30

attempts = 0

begin
  attempts += 1
  raise "connection refused" if attempts < 3
  puts "connected on attempt #{attempts}"
rescue RuntimeError => e
  retry if attempts < 3
  puts "gave up: #{e.message}"
end

sections.title: Files
sections.description: Reading, writing, paths, and JSON round trips

snippets.code:
File.write("notes.txt", "first line\nsecond line\n")
puts File.read("notes.txt")

File.open("notes.txt", "a") do |file|
  file.puts "third line"
end

File.foreach("notes.txt") { |line| puts line.chomp }
puts File.exist?("notes.txt")   # true
puts File.size("notes.txt")     # 34

require "fileutils"

puts File.basename("/tmp/report.csv")   # report.csv
puts File.dirname("/tmp/report.csv")    # /tmp
puts File.extname("/tmp/report.csv")    # .csv

FileUtils.mkdir_p("tmp/out")
Dir.glob("data/*.csv").sort.each { |name| puts name }
puts File.join("data", "notes.txt")     # data/notes.txt

require "json"

File.write("config.json", JSON.generate({ port: 5432 }))
config = JSON.parse(File.read("config.json"))
puts config["port"]   # 5432

sections.title: Gems and Bundler
sections.description: Declaring dependencies, locking versions, and packaging

snippets.code:
# Gemfile
source "https://rubygems.org"

ruby "3.3.0"

gem "rack", "~> 3.1"
gem "rake", "~> 13.2"

group :test do
  gem "minitest", "~> 5.25"
end

# Install one gem at a pinned version
gem install rack -v 3.1.8

# Show installed versions of a gem
gem list rack

# Add a dependency without editing the Gemfile by hand
bundle add faraday

# Show gems that have newer releases
bundle outdated

# Update one gem, keeping the rest locked
bundle update rack

# greet.gemspec
Gem::Specification.new do |spec|
  spec.name = "greet"
  spec.version = "0.1.0"
  spec.summary = "Print a greeting from the command line"
  spec.authors = ["Grace Hopper"]
  spec.files = Dir["lib/**/*.rb", "bin/*"]
  spec.bindir = "bin"
  spec.executables = ["greet"]
  spec.required_ruby_version = ">= 3.1"
end

sections.title: Testing
sections.description: Minitest and RSpec with the commands that run them

snippets.code:
require "minitest/autorun"

class Calculator
  def self.add(a, b)
    raise ArgumentError, "negatives not allowed" if a.negative? || b.negative?
    a + b
  end
end

class CalculatorTest < Minitest::Test
  def test_adds_two_numbers
    assert_equal 5, Calculator.add(2, 3)
  end

  def test_rejects_negative_input
    error = assert_raises(ArgumentError) { Calculator.add(-1, 2) }
    assert_equal "negatives not allowed", error.message
  end
end

# spec/calculator_spec.rb
require "calculator"

RSpec.describe Calculator do
  it "adds two numbers" do
    expect(described_class.add(2, 3)).to eq(5)
  end

  it "rejects negative input" do
    expect { described_class.add(-1, 2) }.to raise_error(ArgumentError)
  end
end

# Run the whole RSpec suite
bundle exec rspec

# Run one file and one example by line number
bundle exec rspec spec/calculator_spec.rb:6

# Run Minitest through Rake
bundle exec rake test

# Run a Minitest file directly
ruby -Itest test/calculator_test.rb
